svg.title: PAMGuard wrap display
svg.text: Archetype 4 — the wrap display: what a live waterfall really shows ahead of “now”
PAMGuard, the one live tool in the acoustic family — and it defaults to wrap, not scroll [A32, A33]
the PREVIOUS sweep, still on screen
The canvas stays still and the edge sweeps across it. Nothing goes blank ahead of “now”; the region ahead
holds the last sweep's data until it is overwritten.
Reading for A3: even the survey's one live analysis tool does not withhold the region ahead of the playhead.
